region.note: Each routine's extent is taken as the gap to the next CALL_NATIVE target, so a routine that shares a region with helpers reads larger than its own body.

method: For each target the words up to the next target are decoded and scanned for `bl 0x02054A34` (a script argument read, with the literal index it asks for), `bl 0x02054A24` (a yield), any other `bl`, and every base-plus-displacement load or store. Nothing is named and no meaning is inferred.
